digest.component_or_area: backend neutrality sweep & Jira adapter architecture
propositions: inbound_fields.py must remain rooted at the reconciler package root to preserve the J7 sibling-adapter seal between adapters/jira/ and adapters/jira_datacenter/, since both concrete backends share the same mapper and moving it into either adapter would violate the bidirectional import contract

the backend neutrality sweep exemption for inbound_fields.py is a permanent architectural cost, not temporary relocation debt, because every alternative destination either breaks the J7 seal or violates the mirror-image rule forbidding root-core importers from consuming adapters/jira_family/
the exemption comment and test diagnostic must be rewritten to explain the durable J7 reason instead of claiming ticket 556a will relocate the module

the module's by-path lazy-load of adapters/jira/adf.py cannot be satisfied if relocated to adapters/jira_family/ without laundering the AST contract via path-string routing instead of proper import wiring
